タイトル: Optimization-driven tool with extremely good support and service.
投稿者: Gianna アメリカのAccounting and Finance 飲食店, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Optimization-driven tool with extremely good support and service."
良い点: The support from customer support managers and support staff, and the fact that the tool is extremely future-oriented and constantly releases new features that create absolute added value, especially in customer communication and sales. We often use this tool to work on optimizing our strategy, understanding our client's needs better and helping us become more efficient in our tasks.
改善点: I've noticed only two negative aspects of GoTo Connect. Firstly, calls sometimes fail to connect. This is obviously inconvenient when speaking with customers. Secondly, assigned calls are often not found in the 'To Do's' list.

投稿者: Cindy アメリカのLaw Clerk 弁護士業界, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great Product"
良い点: Reliable cloud phone and UCaaS platform Strong call quality and uptime Easy mobile and desktop apps Helpful customer support Rich feature set, including AI receptionist, SMS, video meetings, and integrations
改善点: Initial setup and call routing can have a learning curve Some users report occasional call quality or connectivity issues Complex administration for advanced configurations Mixed experiences with support after onboarding for some organizations

タイトル: Reachable everywhere with just one number
投稿者: Oliver ドイツのCFO 薬品, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Reachable everywhere with just one number"
良い点: Offers the essential functions we need in our business context and also provides exciting features we haven't used before. Inquiries are answered the same day, even by phone. We've rarely experienced such a a good onboarding process.
改善点: So far, we have not been able to identify any negative aspects and are pleased to have discovered GoTo Connect.

タイトル: WE DO NOT RECOMMEND!!! WHAT A TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE.
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 消費者サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "WE DO NOT RECOMMEND!!! WHAT A TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE."
良い点: ABSOLUTELY AWFUL EXPERIENCE!!!! We are two weeks in and searching for something else. There is absolutely NOTHING that we liked about GoToConnect. They sold us on something that didnt work, sold us the wrong amount of licenses, and then support continually told us "we will get it fixed after we hang up" to do absolutely NOTHING after. We show up the next day and the phones still dont work, there's no response, no communication back to us, and no actual help after spending hours on the phone the previous day. WE DO NOT RECOMMEND!!!
改善点: ABSOLUTELY AWFUL EXPERIENCE!!!! We are two weeks in and we have spent 30 hours trying to get anything to work. We are missing calls for days. We are a simple, small business with just 2 locations, 4 phones, 2 managers, and over and over support couldn't get it right and then our CSM spent days fixing it for it to break over and over. WE WILL NEVER BE BACK. WE DO NOT RECOMMEND!!!!

投稿者: Shane アメリカのowner-CEO 建設, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "goto connect"
良い点: Ease of use with consolidated services. They have good phone & customer support with quick results. Their pricing structure is good.
改善点: The initial set up was a bit confusing and trying to navigate their bubble system when routing calls is confusing.

タイトル: Best One-on-One Meeting Site for on the go
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 医療機器, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Best One-on-One Meeting Site for on the go"
良い点: I appreciate the simplicity it has in allowing clients to connect without needing a downloaded application.
改善点: That even with a paid subscription I only have about half an hour for meetings. Sometimes they need to be longer.

投稿者: LaWanda アメリカのConcierge Representative 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "GoTo phone app"
良い点: I like that I can take my extension with me as I go from office to remotely at home, and that I can use the app, should I not have my laptop available.
改善点: It stinks that if the internet connection goes out, then I have no access to my extension, and that if I am at home, and someone is in the office and needs a phone, they cannot use the physical phone at my desk if I'm logged in at home.

投稿者: David アメリカのPresident 事務用品、事務機器, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Very Powerful and complete"
良い点: Currently, one of the best features of Goto Connect is the new AI feature. It allows an AI receptionist for very reasonable rates. It has all the other standard features you expect from a VOIP provider and the pricing is very reasonable. ALSO, the quality is ALWAYS perfect. Another great feature is the outgoing VM message can be typed in and it will create a very high quality computer generated voice to play.
改善点: The learning curve for Goto Connect can be a little steep. Not that it is difficult, there are just a lot of options you can use. There are lots of video tutorials to get you through it.

投稿者: Ian アメリカのUndisclosed 建設, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "Worst customer experience EVER"
良い点: GoTo Connect is hands down the most useless, dishonest company I’ve ever dealt with. They couldn’t even manage to set up my account or activate my service, yet they were lightning-fast to charge my credit card for something I couldn’t use. No welcome call, no setup, no access — nothing but bills. When I tried to cancel, they hid behind some bogus “contract” even though I never once had a working account. They literally told me they were going to keep charging me for a service that never existed. Unreal.
改善点: Their support team is a black hole of incompetence — endless hold times, scripted apologies, and zero actual help. Every “manager” promises to call you back, but none of them ever do. The only way I finally stopped the bleeding was by canceling my card so they couldn’t keep stealing from me.

良い点: I enjoy the video conferencing and AI tools of the platform. For the most part, it’s user-friendly and a convenient tool to use.
改善点: Sometimes there are some lags in the system with the audio portion of the platform and I’ve had some issues in the past with the call summarization and transcription.

投稿者: Brittany アメリカのCollections Manager 自動車, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Excellent meeting software"

改善点: I've only used the very basic functions in GoTo Meeting, so I don't have extensive knowledge. So far, no cons.

改善点: Non that I can think of

投稿者: chris カナダのPartner 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "Poor choice of phone system"

改善点: Doesn't facilitate being able to have a live person answer a call when a customer calls a specific extension. ie- When [sensitive content hidden] isn't at his desk and someone calls him I want to pick up his calls.

投稿者: Michael アメリカのOwner エンタテインメント, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Manage Communications Better"
良い点: Connecting is better because we only need one service and it's all stored together. After I set it up I liked it. Not hard to use at all. Everything is right where you need and expect it to be. With a good internet provider and connection there are no quality or speed problems. Real time chat is important to us and lets us connect instantly from different places without the interruption of video or voice calls. We're often filming and can't talk on the phone. I don't have to pay a lot for Goto Connect so that makes me like it even more. I think they charge what it's worth.
改善点: Sometimes getting help from customer support can be frustrating and hard. I don't always think they help the situation. If the internet connection is fuzzy then so are all of our communications. After it's restored it takes a while to catch up. But if you have a good provider there's no need to worry.

改善点: The only "hard" part about using this software was setting it up, but that's because we didn't have experience changing service providers. Jive was extremely helpful and made the process really easy.

投稿者: Alan アメリカのPrincipal Consultant 非営利団体運営, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Great Customer Service"
良い点: I have been very impressed with the great customer service I have received from Jive in launching my business. They have great bundled services available.
改善点: I did not find the user interface intuitive and was disappointed that no pre-recorded greetings were available to expedite the initial set-up.

投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 建設, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Jive Telephone System"
良い点: The Jive system is a user friendly platform. I really like the fact that we have access to all of our information, without having to contact customer support. I like that we can upload a file for our hold music & can change it whenever we want to. I really like the auto attendant & how easy it is to change things. Once I got familiar with the system, I feel very comfortable updating anything that is needed, but if I can't figure it out, I know I can contact customer service & they are great!
改善点: I think that it took a while to get our phone numbers ported over & at first our temporary numbers weren't "spoofed" so on our caller id, it was some odd telephone number without our company name. There was a few items setting up our system that was kind of frustrating but, once we were connected to the right person, it was an easy process. Most of the issues were more getting things worked out the first few weeks that we had the Jive telephone system. There was a different group of customer service people that we dealt with during that process, I feel that some of those people weren't as knowledgeable as the regular customer service employees. Again, once the few kinks were worked out, we've had no issues. It was more getting hooked up with the right person that could fix the specific issue that we were having.

投稿者: Brad アメリカのIT Consultant コンピュータ・ネットワーク, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "My Experience with Jive Voice"
良い点: Software on the Jive Portal is very easy to use. It has so many features that haven't even been tapped into yet. Software is easy to figure out and if there is a question tech support is always very helpful and explain what they are doing should they need to remote in to assist you.
改善点: Haven't had anything to dislike about it yet.

投稿者: Jamey アメリカのPartner 弁護士業界, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Best Customer Service"

改善点: Given that it's internet based, when the power goes out the phones go out. That comes with the territory though.

改善点: Setting up the system is a complex thing (lots of things to set up initially) but the customer assistance specialists are amazing and the functionality is worth much more than any time spent setting up.

タイトル: Can't beat the pricing but does need some work

We've called Jive Support for help but the action taken has been very slow and to much avail.
